description_i18n.en: Follow a path through light cones, spacetime intervals, cosmic time, and the questions that reshape our picture of the universe.

note_i18n.en: Begin with the causal structure that sets the trail's foundation.
Turn that picture into a way of classifying separation in spacetime.
Connect relativity to a cosmic clock shared across the universe.
Use cosmology to rethink what a center would mean.
End at the frontier where spacetime itself may cease to be fundamental.
